families.title: API collections lose the partial last page

tasks.prompt: API clients that page through user lists lose users. A client calls `GET /api/users?per_page=5` and keeps requesting the URL in `_links.next` until it is `null`: with 12 users it receives only 10 of them, and `_meta.total_pages` says 2. The same happens for a user's followers and following lists (`GET /api/users/<id>/followers`, `GET /api/users/<id>/following`) whenever the number of entries is not a multiple of `per_page`; when it is a multiple, everything is correct. Expected: following the `next` links reaches every entry exactly once, the `next` link of the last page is `null`, and `_meta.total_pages` is the real number of pages. Fix the cause. The API responses must keep their format, and the project's tests must still pass.

families.title: last_seen shifted by the server's UTC offset

tasks.prompt: A user's "last seen" time is wrong when the server does not run in UTC. After a user browses the site, `GET /api/users/<id>` reports their `last_seen` (e.g. `2026-03-01T15:30:00+00:00`) shifted by the server's UTC offset: on a server in UTC+05:30 it lies 5 hours 30 minutes in the future, and the "Last seen on" line of the profile page is off by the same amount. On a server that runs in UTC it looks right. Expected: `last_seen` is the time of the user's last request, in UTC, whatever the server's time zone; values that were stored correctly before must still be reported as they are. Fix the cause. Make sure the project's tests still pass.

families.title: How posts reach the search index

tasks.prompt: When someone writes a new post, how does it end up in the full-text search index, and what turns indexing off? Do not change any files. End your reply with a block that starts with a line `ANSWER:` followed by one `key: value` line per key: `listener` (the method, as `Class.method`, that after a successful database commit hands new and changed posts to the indexing function), `event` (the name of the database session event that method is registered for), `indexer` (the function, as `module.function`, that writes one object into the search index), `fields` (the class attribute, as `Class.attribute`, that lists which fields of a post are indexed), `switch` (the name of the configuration setting that, when empty, turns indexing off).

Logged-in users see a number next to "Messages" in the navigation bar. Where does it come from and when does it go back to zero? Do not change any files. End your reply with a block that starts with a line `ANSWER:` followed by one `key: value` line per key: `count` (the method, as `Class.method`, that computes the number), `cutoff` (the attribute, as `Class.attribute`, whose value decides which messages still count), `fallback` (the date, as `YYYY-MM-DD`, used for that decision when the user has never opened their messages), `reset` (the view, as `blueprint.function` like in `url_for`, whose request sets the number back to zero), `poll` (the view, as `blueprint.function`, that the page's script requests periodically to update the number without reloading the page).

Add automated tests that pin down how the token authentication of the JSON API behaves today. Do not change any application code: only add tests, in `tests.py` or in new `test_*.py` files in the repository root, using the project's `unittest` style. The behavior to pin down: `POST /api/tokens` with the HTTP Basic credentials of a user returns status `200` and a JSON object with a `token`; a wrong password or an unknown user gets `401`. A new token is valid for one hour. Asking for a token again while the current one has more than a minute left returns the same token; with a minute or less left, a new token is issued. Token-protected endpoints such as `GET /api/users/<id>` accept a valid token (`Authorization: Bearer <token>`) and answer `401` for a missing, unknown or expired token. `DELETE /api/tokens` with a valid token returns `204`, after which that token is rejected with `401`. All tests must pass on the current code.

Split the models module `app/models.py` into a package `app/models/` without changing any behavior. `app/models/mixins.py` defines `SearchableMixin` and `PaginatedAPIMixin`; `app/models/user.py` defines the `followers` association table, `User` and the Flask-Login user loader `load_user`; `app/models/post.py` defines `Post`; `app/models/message.py` defines `Message`; `app/models/notification.py` defines `Notification`; `app/models/task.py` defines `Task`. Every class, table and function is defined in its new module, and `app/models/__init__.py` re-exports all of these names, so every existing `from app.models import ...` keeps working. `app/models.py` no longer exists. The application and the project's tests must keep working.

families.title: Send a private message through the API

tasks.prompt: Add a JSON API endpoint for sending a private message: `POST /api/messages`. It uses the same token authentication as the existing `GET /api/users/<id>` endpoint (no or an invalid token: status `401`); the sender is the user who owns the token. The request body is a JSON object with `recipient` (the recipient's username, a string) and `body` (the message text, a string of 1 to 140 characters). On success it returns status `201` with a JSON object with the fields `id` (number), `body` (string), `timestamp` (the message time in UTC as an ISO 8601 string with an explicit `+00:00` offset, e.g. `2024-05-01T10:30:00+00:00`), `sender` and `recipient` (each an object with exactly the fields `id` (number) and `username` (string)). A request whose body is not such a JSON object, lacks a field, has a field of the wrong type, or has an empty text or a text longer than 140 characters gets status `400` with a JSON error object like the API's other validation errors; an unknown recipient gets status `404` with a JSON error object. Nothing is stored for a rejected request. Sending through the API must have the same effects for the recipient as sending a message from the web interface. The existing endpoints and pages must keep working unchanged. Make sure the project's tests still pass.
